patch_list: True black dark mode for AMOLED screens.
Restores the captured PairIP startup data (string constants and lifecycle dispatch) and disables the integrity, license and VM startup checks, so a re-signed patched dynamicSpot starts normally.
Removes the BLYTZA home promotion, rating row and nags, special offers and promotional notifications.
Newly installed apps are no longer added to the notification apps list in the background; every app is only shown after you enable it yourself.
Unlocks locally enforced Pro settings, animations, colors and music controls, removes ads and skips the onboarding paywall without creating a Play purchase.
